## Rules

- all new objects use `additionalProperties:false`; a policy rule contains only `scope` (`system|tenant|user|tool`) and closed `verdict` (`deny|ask|allow`); confirmation state binds proposal id/version, covered principal, token id, prepared/current descriptor digest and prepared/commit args fingerprint; audit export binds adapter id/mapping version, external boundary and explicit attribute names. These are driver-only inputs, never wire fields or self-asserted verdicts. `RAG:— (repo-grounded: @plan/knowledge/research-18-p4-driver-contract-remediation-2026-08.json §3)`.

## Guidance

Preserve existing P4.9 sections and bytes. Do not place data in `journal.payload`, `expect`, titles, a generic `context`, or `additionalProperties:true`; every section gets one valid probe and one one-field invalid probe through the real Draft 2020-12 schema graph. If a required behavior needs a field beyond these contracts, block and add a D-record rather than inventing a carrier-local convention.
